record.summary: Guidance framework from the AI Governance Center (AIGC) at ETDA for executives of organisations that use AI. It sets three components: an AI governance structure (governance council, roles and responsibilities, competency building), an AI strategy (responsible-AI strategy and AI risk management, citing ISO/IEC 23894 and the NIST AI RMF, with human-in, over or out-of-the-loop levels) and AI operation (lifecycle governance, user information and feedback channels). It links to Thailand's six AI ethics principles and to toolkits for readiness assessment, use-case canvas and risk assessment.
record.notes: Listed under 2023 on the AIGC research and recommendations page; the stored English document is an 18-slide presentation version prepared by the AIGC team. The English title on both the page and the slides is 'Guideline for Executive' (singular). The framework is for organisations' own use; neither stored text sets obligations.

verification.note: Stored: the ETDA AIGC research and recommendations page (lists the guideline under 2023) and the English slide deck. The page and slides confirm the English title and the three-component framework. No exact publication day is given; the year comes from the page listing, where it sits above the title in the page text. The Thai-language title, the names 'AI Governance Center' and Ministry of Digital Economy and Society, and the later developments (generative AI guideline of Oct 2024, Cabinet endorsement request of Sept 2025, rename to AIGPC, 2027 sandbox) are not in the stored text and rest on earlier research or press. The non-binding status is inferred from the document's nature, not stated in it.
